notes.title: Update 1.9
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/379f027db323c8a81307953060fd108731eea560.png
Hello everyone, I provide you with a small 1.9  update.

Additions

 Added new 3d mini-game - 'Basketball'
 Added lower floor
 Ability to sprint 'shift' key


The next updates will be cosmetic. By popular demand I will add new clothes.

notes.title: Update 1.85
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/92988e65adf9432c850b2a8aa39bcef728316ec9.png
Hello everyone again, there is a new update 1.85, which added a couple of new things.

IMPORTANT! Now the old save is not supported! I apologize for the inconvenience. You can always go to menu-cheats to spawn any amount of money.


Changes/additions

 Updated breast physics (nvidia physx)
 Added 2 settings to edit the shape of the breast
 Added the ability to remove clothes (to buy it, go to the shop)
 Added ability to walk. Click on the 'WALK' button on the top left corner
 Updated 3d models house and street

notes.title: Update 1.7
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/9ea18ad2ebba3bd9189dbc53ad08c0de38861daf.png
I welcome you all and announce the new update 1.7. The update list includes:

 Added a new pose "split". You can buy it at the store for $ 700.
 Added the ability to dance (top left corner select "Dance ($100)". While there are 3, but I'll add them! There is also a new room with a swimming pool for dancing.
 Fix bugs with saves


Don't forget to suggest your ideas for the game in the discussions tab! Until next time!

notes.title: 1.6 Update is live
notes.content:
I present to you the new update 1.6!
Added:

 The ability to change the lighting of the lamp.
 Ability to change the time of day.
 Ability to remove HUD (all the inscriptions on the screen) using the key 'F1'
 Shadow enhancement

notes.title: 1.5 Big update
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35104944/8b8522aeba080f1fafe257cab938ae5e4e2786f3.png I am glad to announce the release of a new update. I hope you will like it.

Changes

 Added a new feature for the girl: skin reflection
 Improve girl skin / chest
 Added new pose for s*xual contact (Pose 6)
Now you can take unlimited amount of money if you do not want to earn! (You need to go to the 'menu' and select 'cheats' and press on 'Take' button) 1 button = 50$
 Chest physics fixed
 Added realistic sounds during s*xual contact.
 Added more realistic face animation during s*xual contact


See you later!
